name: agent-remote-driver-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-remote-driver on a fresh machine and prove its launch-time baseline-drivability contract end-to-end -- no agent-worktrees or agent-bridge installed in the venue, NO model turn submitted (genuinely credit-free: a bare interactive `copilot` session is kept alive under a pty via `script`, with no prompt ever typed). A live copilot session writes a discovery descriptor at ~/.copilot/remote-driver/sessions/<id>.json, the driver's HTTP surface (/health, /events, /send) answers over loopback with the descriptor's bearer token (never persisted unredacted), bin/list-sessions.mjs's aggregated view reflects the live session, and a SIGTERM cleanly removes the descriptor (installSignalCleanup). Name-free / public.

config.CR_MARKETPLACE_REPO: ThomasMichon/copilot-extensions (or a container-local directory mounted with -HarnessMount for uncommitted-worktree validation)

stages.title: live session writes a discovery descriptor (no model turn)
drive the session over its HTTP surface (/health, /events, /send)
bin/list-sessions.mjs aggregated view reflects the live session
SIGTERM is handled cleanly and removes the discovery descriptor
